verdict.rationale: Orrick's own Cyber, Privacy & Data Innovation practice page says the group works to "reduce cyber risk" and notes that its partners are recognized among the most sought-after advisors for incident response. That shows the firm does incident-response work, but only through a recognition mention, not a described service. missing for 10: explicit description of the breach-response service, regulator-facing work (notifications, investigations, enforcement defense), detail on incident-response scope or matters, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm handles security-incident and breach response, including regulator-facing work, documented on its own pages

citations.quote: Orrick's Cyber, Privacy & Data Innovation Group partners with technology-driven companies to maximize data value, address global compliance requirements and reduce cyber risk
named to the peer-reviewed list, recognizing the most sought-after legal advisors for incident response
